name: JBL Control
author: Ahmad Elyan
description: JBL earbuds and headphones in the Omarchy bar: left/right/case battery, noise cancelling / Ambient Aware / TalkThru, EQ presets and a 10-band custom EQ, VoiceAware, Find My Buds and the rest of the JBL Headphones app's settings, over the buds' own Bluetooth control channel.

barWidget.description: Battery, noise control, EQ and settings for JBL earbuds and headphones (Wave Buds 2, Tune, Live, Vibe and more).

schema.label: Headphones address
schema.description: Bluetooth address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF) of the JBL device to control. Leave empty to use whichever JBL device is connected.

schema.label: Show battery in the bar
schema.description: Show the emptier bud's battery next to the icon.

schema.label: Modes to cycle
schema.description: Listening modes the scroll wheel and the cycleAnc IPC call step through. Leave empty for every mode the device has.

options.label: TalkThru
options.description: Lower the music and boost voices

schema.label: On-screen display on mode change
schema.description: Show the Omarchy OSD when the listening mode changes, from the bar, a keybinding or the buds' own touch control.

schema.label: Low battery warning (%)
schema.description: Send a notification when a bud drops to this level. 0 turns it off.
